description: Kontour Survey review MCP server (stdio): inspects a review-queue session and serves the review card as a declared MCP Apps (SEP-1865) `ui://survey/review-card/queue` resource (mimeType text/html;profile=mcp-app), readable by Station's MCP-UI host via resources/read. Tools inspect the queue and append accept/hold/reject decisions back to the session file atomically. Reference it as an `mcp-tool-ui` layout component once installed. Replace the <session path> placeholder with a Survey review-session JSON file (the durable decision store).
